## SessionResourceClient.resolve() method

Read a session identity across all tabs of its Window. A move to another Window makes this identity missing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
resolve(windowId: string | number, sessionId: string, __mactsOptions?: _macts_contracts.CallOptions): Promise<Session>;
```
